in_sanskrit.name: विष्ठा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is immovable or steadfast, invincible, and fearless.

in_hindi.name: विष्ठम
in_hindi.long_meaning: विषय से विदालित होना, स्थिर रहना, अपराध करने वाला, असत्य वाक्य बोलना और अपने वचन को पूरा करना

in_telugu.name: బీశ్మ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is immovable, unyielding, and has the power to grant boons.

in_marathi.name: Bheeshma
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dedicated to Lord Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bheeshma हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bheeshma is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bhishma’, meaning ‘dedicated to Lord Vishnu’. He is a prominent figure in Hindu mythology, known for his unwavering devotion and bravery.
